review_policy.primary_topic: Dominant assessed topic by marks and prompt intent.
review_policy.secondary_topics: Substantial mark-bearing cross-topic skills that should count for paper coverage without erasing the primary topic.
review_policy.coverage_topics: primary_topic plus secondary_topics; used for at-least-one-topic paper coverage checks.
review_policy.ordinary_de_integration_policy: Routine integration inside a separable differential-equation question is not counted as a separate integration overlap unless the prompt separately assesses an integration topic outside the DE objective.
review_policy.batch_storage_policy: This batch stores changed, excluded, or secondary-coverage decisions only; unchanged labels remain inherited from the current packet manifests.
